title: A test lint flags a `" + NAME + "` concatenation inside one string literal in hooks/test_*.py
why: Lane env-file-shell-c (session_013NEJKytPs46Qp4KDoqbDvz), relayed by the coordinator 14:28 CST Nov 8: a test-author wrote `'" + ENV + "'` inside one Python string literal, so 8 guard test cases never named the env file and passed green while testing nothing. The lane caught it by probe. No test-lint step covers it (triage grep). Scan with the Python tokenizer, so a real concatenation outside a literal is not flagged.
